international.canonicalTopic: BRICS Heads of Tax Authorities Meeting 2026
international.headline: BRICS tax administrations meet in New Delhi
facts: The BRICS Heads of Tax Authorities meeting took place in New Delhi on September 23, 2026, as the concluding event of India’s presidency of the BRICS tax cooperation framework.
Tax administrations from Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and the UAE participated.
The meeting aimed to strengthen cooperation and coordination among participating BRICS tax administrations.
international.summary: The meeting concluded India’s presidency of the BRICS tax cooperation framework and focused on coordination among tax authorities.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The meeting was held in New Delhi on September 23, 2026.
international.mainsAngle: Discuss the importance of international coordination between tax administrations.

national.headline: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY completes eight years
facts: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), launched on 2018-09-23, marked eight years on 2026-09-23.
The scheme covers over 60 crore people and provides eligible families cashless health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
The notes report 1,961 treatment procedures across 27 medical specialties and more than 48.54 crore Ayushman Cards created as of 2026-09-23.
The scheme is implemented by the National Health Authority under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
national.summary: AB PM-JAY marked eight years, providing eligible families with cashless cover for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation; the notes reported more than 48.54 crore Ayushman Cards by the anniversary date.
national.staticLink: Publicly funded health assurance and secondary and tertiary hospitalisation coverage.
national.prelimsTakeaway: PM-JAY offers ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year; its implementing agency is the National Health Authority.
national.mainsAngle: Evaluate the role of publicly funded health assurance in improving access to hospital care and reducing financial hardship.

national.headline: Surya Festival founder Surya Krishnamoorthy dies in Thiruvananthapuram
facts: Surya Krishnamoorthy died in Thiruvananthapuram on 2026-09-23 aged 78.
He was a theatre director, cultural organiser and former ISRO scientist.
He founded the Surya Festival in 1977; it features Indian classical dance, music, theatre, cinema and other performing arts.
national.summary: Theatre director and cultural organiser Surya Krishnamoorthy, founder of Kerala’s Surya Festival and a former ISRO scientist, died aged 78.
national.staticLink: ISRO was established in 1969 and functions under the Department of Space.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Surya Krishnamoorthy founded the Surya Festival in 1977.
national.mainsAngle: The role of cultural festivals in sustaining and presenting India’s performing arts.
